tools.name: ascension_chamber
tools.title: Chamber state
tools.description: Read the ASCENSION Chamber state: Destiny, ΔK/ΔU/ΔW, Guardian verdict, last verified transition, developmental/lifecycle state and manifestation readiness.

tools.name: ascension_knowledgeverse
tools.title: Knowledgeverse
tools.description: Read the ASCENSION Knowledgeverse: Meaning Elements, Knowledge Forms, relationships, emergence candidates, entity IDs/SIDs and lineage.

include_knowledge_forms.description: Include the full published Knowledge Form documents (large). Defaults to false.

tools.name: ascension_pathways
tools.title: Pathways / DTF
tools.description: Read ASCENSION Pathways (DTF/Transverse): branch comparison, trajectory effects, confidence and uncertainty, constraints, emergence points, balance evaluation and any published Wisdom recommendation.

tools.name: ascension_governance
tools.title: Governance
tools.description: Read the ASCENSION governance layer: active constraints, applicable / remembered-not-applicable / superseded categories, Guardian state and the provenance and evidence basis.

tools.name: ascension_ledger
tools.title: Verified Δ ledger
tools.description: Read the ASCENSION Verified Δ ledger records: hash-chain continuity (previous_hash → record_hash), execution receipts, verification state and transformation lineage.

limit.description: Maximum number of most recent records to return. Defaults to all.

tools.name: ascension_library_card
tools.title: Library Card
tools.description: Read the Library Card / glossary record for one ASCENSION entity: ID, SID, WHO/WHAT/WHY, chromosome/genesis state where published, Meaning Elements, lineage and relationships.

entity_id.description: Entity ID, e.g. ENTITY:operator. Use ascension_knowledgeverse to list available IDs.
